cues.text: Glowing orange lines bleed into a black void like ink.
The painted warrior morphs into a dark, stylized bird.
A standing warrior runs a glowing sword through a kneeling companion. A massive black spaceship ascends.
Three towering, multi-armed robotic entities loom over the warrior.
An armored avian warrior blocks a massive metal hammer with a katana. Glowing orange eyes glare from a red helmet. The warrior slices through the robot's chest armor.
The warrior plunges the sword into the stone ground.
Golden circuitry climbs a colossal, overgrown metallic structure embedded in a lush mountainside.
The ancient ruins hum to life, glowing with orange energy. The mass tears free from the earth, rising as a gigantic spaceship.
The immense vessel ascends through clouds and mist, dwarfing the forested cliffs on either side. Massive engines burn bright against the overcast sky.

beats.note: Black screen.

An ink-wash painting of an armored avian warrior with glowing orange eyes.
The painted warrior morphs into a dark, stylized bird.
Two bird-like figures in black ink. One holds a glowing orange sword over a kneeling companion.
The sword pierces the kneeling figure.
A massive black spaceship ascends.
A fleet of these ships flies past planets.
An ink figure faces three towering, multi-armed robotic entities.
The entities loom over the warrior with whip-like appendages.
An avian warrior fights a robotic entity in ink.
The art morphs into an engraving on a metallic blade.
The scene becomes 3D reality. An armored avian warrior battles a robotic entity in a lush environment.
The warrior blocks a massive metal hammer with a katana.
Glowing orange eyes glare from a red helmet.
The warrior slices through the robot's chest armor.
The warrior plunges the sword into the stone ground.
Golden circuitry spreads from the blade deep into the rock.
The glowing lines climb a colossal, overgrown metallic structure embedded in a lush mountainside.
The ancient ruins hum to life, glowing with orange energy. The colossal mass tears free from the earth, rising as a gigantic spaceship.
The immense vessel ascends through clouds and mist, dwarfing the forested cliffs on either side. Massive engines burn bright against the overcast sky.
Darkness.
